user.title: Google Home Authentication
user.description:
Authenticate with the Google account that manages your Google Home speakers.

**App Password (Recommended)**: Enter your Google Account Email and an App Password generated at [myaccount.google.com/apppasswords](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords).

**Master Token**: If you already have a master token (or oauth token), enter your email and paste the token into Master Token.

import_existing.title: Import Google Home Credentials

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Google authentication servers.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Use a 16-character App Password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). If Google blocks password login, log in at https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup, copy the 'oauth_token' cookie from DevTools (F12 > Storage/Application > Cookies), and paste it into Master Token.
